section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing. Annex templates govern post-award implementation reporting; application form templates (Tier 2A) govern proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B source documents.
Inventing project facts — partner names, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment — not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity — including preparatory drafting — before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority by expanding its scope to redefine phase meanings, tier meanings, or gate logic.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow workflow progress when inputs are incomplete.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is known to be incomplete, contradictory, or unvalidated, without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe programme rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents when those documents are present and accessible.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Section 2.2 contains the regulatory claim: 'in compliance with MSCA open access mandates and Plan S where applicable' — an assertion that MSCA programme rules impose a binding open-access obligation. Section 2.3 contains the regulatory claim: 'Dr. Cholakova's move … constitutes a confirmed European Fellowship placement satisfying the MSCA mobility rule' — an assertion of an MSCA eligibility/participation rule. Neither claim carries a source_ref in the artifact's traceability_footer.primary_sources[] pointing to a path within docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/. The 14 primary_sources listed in the traceability footer are exclusively Tier 2B (expected_impacts.json, expected_outcomes.json, scope_requirements.json), Tier 3 (confirmation_checklist.json, selected_call.json, concept_note.md, project_summary.json, strategic_positioning.md, impacts.json, objectives.json, outcomes.json, workpackage_seed.json), and Tier 4 (impact_architecture.json, canonical_reference_pack.json). No Tier 1 normative framework source is present in the footer. MSCA open-access mandates and the MSCA mobility rule are Horizon Europe regulatory requirements traceable to the General Annexes, Programme Guide, or specific programme regulation — Tier 1 authorities — whose absence from the traceability footer constitutes a §13.9 violation.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Producing outputs in Tier 5 that are not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
